g.text: Ask about any line. Your agent answers in the thread.
You decide what to accept and when the review is done.
Count a timeout as a failed attempt
Three slow calls now end the loop instead of hanging it.
Does a timeout use up an attempt?
Yes. TimeoutError counts as a failure, so the loop ends.
